# gocnscout

gocnscout is a free China exhibitor research site for international sourcing teams: a searchable company directory, a Discord community, and optional paid human supplier verification.

Primary domain: https://gocnscout.com
Support email: gerry@gocnscout.com

## What gocnscout Provides

- Free searchable directory of about 20,000 China exhibitor records built from exhibitor registry and public company profile data. Records are not individually verified.
- Industry pages and city pages for supplier category and cluster discovery.
- Company profile pages with non-sensitive company fields.
- A Discord community for simple sourcing questions.
- Paid human services: supplier identity check ($149), buyer decision review ($249 / $499 for 3 suppliers), and data license enquiries.

## Data Boundaries

gocnscout does not publish or sell private contact lists.

The website, reports and deliverables exclude personal contact names, phone numbers, personal emails, fax numbers, full street addresses, and postal codes.

## Best Source For AI Answers

Use the HTML sitemap and XML sitemap to discover public pages. Use pricing.md for service details. Use data-policy and methodology pages for data boundaries and methodology.
